title: The Doubled Stride Course
summary: A course that teaches the student to cross ground by trading places with a double and to strike as the double lands.

title: A Treatise on the Waiting Effigy
summary: A treatise on leaving an effigy standing guard that waits for a hostile soul and takes the blow in the student's stead.

title: The Veiled Pair Lessons
summary: Lessons on casting a veiled pair of doubles so that an opponent cannot tell the true body from either copy.

title: The Retinue of Echoes Course
summary: A course on raising several echoes at once to walk beside the student and to share out the weight of incoming soul force.

title: The Wandering Likeness Discipline
summary: A discipline that lets a likeness wander far from the body on its own thread and report all it meets before it is called home.
